articles.title: Ukraine working to secure additional air defense systems and missiles – Zelensky
articles.summary: President Zelensky stated that Ukraine is continuing daily efforts to secure additional air defense systems and missiles through contacts with international partners including the Netherlands, Germany, Sweden, France, and the United States.

articles.title: Zelensky confirms second strike on oil refinery in Russia's Ufa
articles.summary: President Zelensky confirmed Ukraine's second strike on an oil refinery in the Russian city of Ufa, describing these attacks as long-range sanctions in response to Russia's continuation of the war.
